review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. smart-base and the loader are byte-identical to the previous review, so the Smart base and the loading path did not move. The Smart runtime changed in two places, both the same edit: the drawer and the context menu, which paint themselves with a raised surface, now carry the dimmed text role for that surface beside it (--sf-on-elevation-4--variant and -2--variant). Without it the dimmed text inside a drawer measured 2.93:1 against its own panel, under the 4.5:1 text needs. No attribute, event, template or keyboard behaviour is touched.
